{{Quote|A world of forests and mountains, almost wholly owned by Count Dooku, one of the first planets to join the Separatists and currently a battle zone.|Anonymous|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Show of Force">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Show of Force]]''</ref>}}
'''Null''' was an arboreal world and the only inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Null system/Legends|Null system]].

==History==
[[File:WhisperbirdsonNull.jpg|thumb|left|[[Whisper bird/Legends|Whisper birds]] on Null during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]
It was the location of a castle retreat of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was one of the first worlds to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A [[Battle of Null (Crimson Nova)|battle]] on Null was fought in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] later [[Battle of Null|struck]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on Null in [[20 BBY/Legends|19.42 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The planet attracted hunters of its native game animals and was home to imported [[Whisper bird/Legends|whisper birds]] from [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Count [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] childhood enemy [[Lorian Nod]] was killed by Dooku's hand on Null.

In the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Null was in [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Zsinj's Empire|Empire]]. Zsinj lost the planet after a combined [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Raid on Null|raid]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
